newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS TUESDAY MIXED.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR STARTS TUESDAY MIXED.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was weaker on the U.S. dollar but stronger against European currencies and the rand in quiet Tuesday morning interbank trade.
"At the moment the market is kind of stable and these are more or less the same levels we saw yesterday," one foreign exchange dealer commented.

At around 0745 GMT the Zimbabwe dollar was quoted at 11.3100/3200 against the U.S. dollar, easing slightly from 11.3085/3185 overnight but was a touch firmer on sterling at 18.3165/3265 compared to 18.3360/3590.
It also gained on the mark to 6.5435/5535 from 6.5515/5590 and to 2.4830/4930 versus South Africa's rand from 2.5390/5585.
